description.narrative: Mali, Malaria, Population Services International (PSI HQ)This program has the following goals: Capacity building in terms of the program's coordination and management. Reduce cases of malaria by at least 75 percent compared to 2000. Reduce malaria-related mortality to a figure close to zero by the end of 2018. The objectives of this program are: At least 80 percent of the population at risk from malaria will benefit from protection measures by the end of 2018 .. By the end of 2018, at least 80 percent of populations will adopt behaviors supporting malaria control measures, in line with national guidelines.. By the end of 2018, at least 90 percent of suspected cases of malaria will be confirmed and treated with recommended antimalarials in all public and private establishments and at the community level.. By the end of 2018, the malaria control program will be reinforced in terms of coordination and management's capacity.
